generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design a professional, distinctive independent proposal logo for the UK vehicle seller "LONDON USED CARS". Transparent background. Motif and colours: a compact architectural L monogram made of two confident road-like strokes, no famous landmark; deep charcoal and petrol blue. One wide horizontal lockup: compact emblem at far left, substantial transparent gap, and the exact full business name to its right in bold beautifully spaced modern lettering. Text must read "LONDON USED CARS" exactly, no extra words or tagline. Keep the emblem inside the left 22% of the canvas, isolated from all text so it can be cropped for a favicon. Flat clean graphic design with thick simple forms, no gradients, no photographic textures, no 3D, no background, no mockup, no decorative tiny lines. Include a crisp white outer keyline around the dark shapes and a fine dark edge on any white shapes so this same transparent artwork remains legible on white, charcoal and dark-red website backgrounds. Restrained expert typography. Compact symbol must remain distinctive at 32px. Not a dealer-approved logo.
